sourceRefs.locator: Site description. City founded in 762, the gates named for four destinations, administrative buildings, central mosque and palace.
The Cambridge World History, chapter 19, 762 foundation under al-Mansur, use of contemporary testimony and later changes of residence.

labels.en: The foundation of a new residence

note.de: Al-Mansur ließ am Tigris die geplante Residenzstadt errichten. Der Kartenpunkt bezeichnet das Gebiet am Westufer. Den genauen Verlauf der Ringmauern können wir dort nicht ablesen.
note.en: Al-Mansur began laying out a new court city by the Tigris. The point marks the area on the western bank. Its ancient circular walls can no longer be traced there.
